questions.prompt: Which colour does hydrogencarbonate indicator show at higher than normal carbon dioxide levels?
questions.why: Higher-than-normal carbon dioxide makes the indicator yellow.
questions.quote: Hydrogencarbonate indicator shows different colours at different levels of carbon dioxide.

questions.prompt: What does Practical 7.9 aim to find out?
questions.why: Practical 7.9 studies carbon dioxide changes in boiling tubes with green leaves.
questions.quote: To find out the changes in carbon dioxide content in boiling tubes with green leaves under light and dark conditions

questions.prompt: How much hydrogencarbonate indicator is added to each tube in Practical 7.9?
questions.why: Practical 7.9 adds 3 cm3 of indicator to each tube.
questions.quote: Add 3 cm3 of hydrogencarbonate indicator to each of four boiling tubes

questions.prompt: Which tubes are wrapped with aluminium foil in Practical 7.9?
questions.why: Tubes C and D are wrapped in foil to make them dark.
questions.quote: Wrap tubes C and D with aluminium foil.

questions.prompt: How long are the four tubes left in bright light in Practical 7.9?
questions.why: The tubes are left in bright light for five hours.

questions.prompt: Approximately what percentage of carbon dioxide is in normal air?
questions.why: Normal air contains about 0.04% carbon dioxide.

questions.prompt: What gas do green plants use during photosynthesis?
questions.why: Plants use carbon dioxide during photosynthesis.
